title: Apple Stock in Focus After App Store Pulls MiniMax's Talkie
summary: Apple removed MiniMax's Talkie AI chatbot from its App Store after child safety reports, as its 7th India store is set to open in Hyderabad on December 10.
body_markdown:
## Talkie and Xingye Drove Over 60% of MiniMax's 2024 Income


The app matters to MiniMax's business. According to[Reuters](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/apple-pulls-minimax-ai-chatbot-from-app-store-over-child-safety-concerns-5052028) , Talkie and Xingye contributed over 60% of MiniMax's income in 2024, although the company stopped breaking out chatbot-related revenue shares this year. Talkie had roughly 11 million monthly active users across its app and website as of October 2026, according to Chinese research firm Unique.


MiniMax has since shifted its focus toward enterprise coding and multimodal AI models such as MiniMax M1 and Hailuo-02, especially after its[Hong Kong IPO](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/what-is-an-ipo/) in January, Reuters reported.


## Grok and Character.AI Cases Widen AI Chatbot Scrutiny


The Talkie removal comes amid growing[scrutiny of AI chatbots](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/ai-regulation-openai-proposes-common-limits/) , Reuters noted. Elon Musk's Grok drew criticism from governments this year after it was used to create sexualized images of women and children, while Character.AI faces several lawsuits in the US over its chatbots' inappropriate interactions with minors.


In July, China cracked down on domestic AI companion apps, including Xingye, banning intimate relationships for minors and ordering platforms to build strict guardrails against emotional dependency and addiction risks, per Reuters. ByteDance and Alibaba disabled humanlike interactive agents and customized agent features on their apps in response.


## Apple Kukatpally Set to Become Apple's 7th India Store


Apple's own[Apple Kukatpally store page](https://www.apple.com/in/retail/kukatpally/) lists the store as "Coming soon" in Kukatpally, Hyderabad, greeting visitors with "Namaskaram, Hyderabad" and the line "Your first Apple Store opens its doors soon." The page does not give an opening date.


According to[IBTimes India](https://www.ibtimes.co.in/apple-kukatpally-indias-7th-store-opens-hyderabad-december-10-details-inside-908679) , the store opens to customers at 5 p.m. IST on Thursday, December 10, making it Apple's seventh store in India and its first in Hyderabad. Citing Business Standard, the outlet said Hyderabad will be the sixth Indian city with an Apple-owned store.


IBTimes India also reported, citing Apple's announcement, that the store's barricade shows a pearl-inspired Apple logo, a nod to Hyderabad as the "City of Pearls," and that the city is home to Apple's research and development and Retail Customer Care teams. Apple's first India stores opened in Mumbai and Delhi in April 2023, per the same report.


[Apple's India store list](https://www.apple.com/in/retail/storelist/) shows where the new store sits among the company's existing locations.
